name: Antigravity Remote Control & Hub
description: Installs Google Antigravity Language Server (v2.9.1) and native agy CLI with full Remote Control & Web UI Hub support.

version.description: Target version of the Antigravity language server engine

enableRemoteControl.description: Enable Google cloud proxy tunnel for access via antigravity.google

enableLocalInterface.description: Enable local Web UI hub server on port 52424/52425

hostname.description: Custom instance nickname for this devcontainer in the antigravity.google dashboard
